# Flagship Growth

> Flagship Growth is a full-service growth and creative agency for CPG (consumer packaged goods) brands selling on Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Walmart. The team provides full account management, paid media (PPC/DSP/Meta Ads), and Amazon content creation (main images, infographics, Premium A+ content, brand stores) — run by senior operators rather than junior account reps.

Flagship Growth has generated $650M+ for clients and scaled 200+ brand partners across 10+ marketplaces and channels, with 20+ years of combined operator experience on the founding team.

## Company

- Founded and led by Joey Giazzon (Co-Founder, Partner Growth) and Vinny Alvarez (Co-Founder, Account Strategy)
- Contact: https://flagshipgrowth.com/contact.html
- About the team and company mission: https://flagshipgrowth.com/about.html

## Services

- Full account management for Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Walmart: https://flagshipgrowth.com/services.html
- Launch Optimization, Growth Strategy, PPC & Paid Media, Creative/SEO/Copy, Advanced Analytics, Market Research
- Amazon content creation: main images, infographics, Premium A+ content, brand stores, listing copy

## Work

- Case studies and client results (Opopop, Rationale Brewing, Mac Energy, Smood Sweets, SuperMush, Reshoevn8r, Dormeo, MAM Baby, Nature's Answer, Wink): https://flagshipgrowth.com/work.html

## Channels served

Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, Target, and Meta Ads management for driving external traffic into marketplace listings.
